subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks of the given series will complete the letter series.

G _ _ A B G H I _ _ G _ I _ B _ H I _ B

options.text: H I A B H A G A
I H A B H A G A
I H A B H A A G
H I B A H A A G

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: G _ _ A B G H I _ _ G _ I _ B _ H I _ B 

Now, put the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) H I A B H A G A → G __**H**__ __**I**__ A B / G H I __**A**__ __**B**__ / G __H__ I __A__ B / __**G**__ H I __A__ B 

Here, '**GHIAB**' followed a pattern.
